title: cyclophorus angustatus
intro: Cyclophorus angustatus, commonly known as the Cyclophorus vine or snake vine, is a plant species native to tropical Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments. The health benefits of Cyclophorus angustatus include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic properties, which can help to alleviate pain, reduce fever, and treat infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its analgesic, antispasmodic, and anti-convulsant properties.
